vocabulary.meaning_en: a group of pages on the internet
vocabulary.note_ar: web = شبكة، site = موقع؛ وكأن الإنترنت عالم حقيقي تزور فيه مكاناً
vocabulary.example: I bought this lamp from a small website.

vocabulary.meaning_en: a program on a phone or computer
vocabulary.note_ar: اختصار لكلمة application
vocabulary.example: Download the app to track your order.

vocabulary.meaning_en: your personal record on a website or in a bank
vocabulary.note_ar: أصلها مالي: bank account، ومنها accountant = محاسب
vocabulary.example: You need an account to save your address.

vocabulary.meaning_en: a secret word you use to enter your account
vocabulary.example: Never share your password with anyone.

vocabulary.meaning_en: the act of entering your account
vocabulary.note_ar: كاسم كلمة واحدة login، وكفعل كلمتان log in
vocabulary.example: The login page is not working.

vocabulary.meaning_en: to enter your account with your name and password
vocabulary.example: Log in to see your past orders.

vocabulary.meaning_en: to create a new account
vocabulary.note_ar: sign = يوقّع، و up تعطي معنى الإكمال: تضع اسمك في قائمة المشتركين
vocabulary.example: It only takes a minute to sign up.

vocabulary.meaning_en: the place on a website where you keep things before you buy them
vocabulary.example: There are three items in my shopping cart.

vocabulary.meaning_en: a list of things you want to buy later
vocabulary.note_ar: wish = أمنية
vocabulary.example: I added the headphones to my wish list.

vocabulary.meaning_en: one thing in a group or list
vocabulary.example: Each item comes with a free gift.

vocabulary.meaning_en: something that is made and sold
vocabulary.example: This product has great reviews.

vocabulary.meaning_en: how big or small something is
vocabulary.example: Do you have this shirt in a bigger size?

vocabulary.meaning_en: red, blue, green, etc.
vocabulary.note_ar: colour بريطاني، color أمريكي
vocabulary.example: What colour do you want?

vocabulary.meaning_en: to put a product in your online cart
vocabulary.note_ar: add = يضيف، ويأخذ حرف الجر to
vocabulary.example: Click "add to cart" and then go to checkout.

vocabulary.meaning_en: bringing goods to a person's home
vocabulary.note_ar: من الفعل deliver = يسلّم + y تحوله لاسم
vocabulary.example: Delivery is free for orders over $50.

vocabulary.meaning_en: sending goods from one place to another
vocabulary.note_ar: من ship = سفينة؛ قديماً كانت البضائع تُنقل بالسفن
vocabulary.example: Shipping takes three to five days.

vocabulary.meaning_en: the address where your order will arrive
vocabulary.example: Please check your shipping address.

vocabulary.meaning_en: the address linked to your bank card
vocabulary.note_ar: bill = فاتورة؛ يطلبه الموقع للتأكد أنك صاحب البطاقة
vocabulary.example: My billing address is different from my home address.

vocabulary.meaning_en: the act of paying money
vocabulary.note_ar: pay + ment تحوّل الفعل إلى اسم
vocabulary.example: Your payment was successful.

vocabulary.meaning_en: a bank card you use to pay and pay back later
vocabulary.example: Can I pay by credit card?

vocabulary.meaning_en: paying in cash when the order arrives
vocabulary.note_ar: اختصارها COD
vocabulary.example: I always choose cash on delivery for new shops.

vocabulary.meaning_en: a request to buy something; to ask for something
vocabulary.example: My order arrived this morning.

vocabulary.meaning_en: the number that identifies your order
vocabulary.example: Customer service asked for my order number.

vocabulary.meaning_en: a message that says something is certain or done
vocabulary.note_ar: من الفعل confirm = يؤكد
vocabulary.example: I got a confirmation email a minute later.

vocabulary.meaning_en: your opinion about a product after using it
vocabulary.note_ar: re = مرة أخرى + view = نظرة
vocabulary.example: I read the reviews before buying.

vocabulary.meaning_en: a score, often in stars
vocabulary.note_ar: من rate = يقيّم
vocabulary.example: The hotel has a five-star rating.

vocabulary.meaning_en: to send something back
vocabulary.note_ar: re = مرة أخرى + turn = يلف
vocabulary.example: I returned the jacket because it was too big.

vocabulary.meaning_en: money given back to you
vocabulary.note_ar: re = مرة أخرى + fund = مال
vocabulary.example: They gave me a full refund.

vocabulary.meaning_en: to give something back and get another one
vocabulary.example: Can I exchange these shoes for a bigger size?

vocabulary.meaning_en: the team that helps buyers with problems
vocabulary.example: I called customer service about the late order.

vocabulary.meaning_en: full of people
vocabulary.note_ar: من crowd = حشد؛ التصريف الثالث كصفة
vocabulary.example: The mall is always crowded on Fridays.

vocabulary.meaning_en: in place of something else
vocabulary.example: I didn't go out. Instead, I ordered pizza.

vocabulary.meaning_en: to move a page up or down on a screen
vocabulary.note_ar: أصلها لفافة الورق القديمة التي تُفتح وتُقرأ
vocabulary.example: She scrolled through the photos.

vocabulary.meaning_en: a group of things put together
vocabulary.note_ar: من collect = يجمع
vocabulary.example: The new winter collection is online now.

vocabulary.meaning_en: soft sports shoes
vocabulary.note_ar: sneakers أمريكي (من sneak لأنها لا تُصدر صوتاً)، trainers بريطاني
vocabulary.example: He wears sneakers every day.

vocabulary.meaning_en: a small flat case for money and cards
vocabulary.example: I left my wallet in the car.

vocabulary.meaning_en: animal skin used to make shoes and bags
vocabulary.example: She bought a leather bag.

vocabulary.meaning_en: with attention, to avoid mistakes
vocabulary.example: Read the size guide carefully.

vocabulary.meaning_en: certain, without doubt
vocabulary.note_ar: sure about = متأكد من
vocabulary.example: I'm not sure about this colour.

vocabulary.meaning_en: to call, email or write to someone
vocabulary.note_ar: لا تأخذ حرف جر: contact someone وليس contact with
vocabulary.example: Please contact us if you have a problem.

vocabulary.meaning_en: to put something somewhere for others to see
vocabulary.note_ar: leave a review / leave a comment
vocabulary.example: Please leave a comment below.

vocabulary.meaning_en: to find the size of something
vocabulary.note_ar: تُنطق /ˈmeʒər/؛ الحرفان ea يُنطقان e قصيرة
vocabulary.example: Measure the window before you buy curtains.

vocabulary.meaning_en: an interactive program you use in a browser
vocabulary.note_ar: يختلف عن website الذي يعرض معلومات ثابتة
vocabulary.example: Online banking is a web app, not just a website.

fine_lines.title: choose vs select
fine_lines.explanation_ar: choose تعني الاختيار بين بدائل مختلفة عن بعضها (طريقة دفع، مرشح في الانتخابات، شريك حياة). select تعني اختيار شيء من قائمة فيها أشياء متشابهة (من قائمة الطعام، من مقاسات أو ألوان). إذا لم يكن الفرق واضحاً فالكلمتان صحيحتان: choose توحي بأن ما اخترته مميز عن غيره، و select توحي بأنك أخذت واحداً من مجموعة متشابهة.

examples.sentence: He selected a pizza from the menu.
He chose to pay in cash.
It was hard to choose between the two jobs.
Select your size from the list.

fine_lines.title: website vs web app
fine_lines.explanation_ar: website موقع يعرض صفحات ومعلومات ثابتة تقرؤها فقط. web app تطبيق تفاعلي يعمل داخل المتصفح، فيه حساب شخصي وقاعدة بيانات وعمليات مثل الشراء والتحويل البنكي. لذلك عندما تشتري من متجر كبير عبر المتصفح فأنت تستخدم web app.

examples.sentence: The museum's website shows its opening hours.
I pay my bills through the bank's web app.

fine_lines.title: too small vs very small
fine_lines.explanation_ar: too تعني «أكثر من اللازم» لدرجة أن الشيء لا يناسبك ولا تستطيع التعامل معه. very تعني «جداً» فقط، ويمكن أن يبقى الشيء مقبولاً. too expensive يعني لا أستطيع شراءه، و very expensive يعني غالٍ لكن ربما أشتريه.

examples.sentence: The shoes were too small, so I couldn't wear them.
The phone is very expensive, but I'll buy it.

fine_lines.title: sneakers vs trainers
fine_lines.explanation_ar: نفس المعنى (حذاء رياضي). sneakers أشيع في أمريكا وكندا، وأصلها من sneak لأن الحذاء لا يُصدر صوتاً عند المشي. trainers أشيع في بريطانيا.

examples.sentence: Put on your trainers, we're going running.

fine_lines.title: login vs log in
fine_lines.explanation_ar: login كلمة واحدة وهي اسم (صفحة أو عملية تسجيل الدخول). log in كلمتان وهي فعل مركب (يسجّل الدخول). نفس القاعدة مع signup / sign up.

examples.sentence: I can't log in to my account.

expressions.example: I placed an order for two books yesterday.
After paying, you get an order number.
Please leave a review if you liked the product.

expressions.phrase: leave a comment / post a comment
expressions.example: She posted a comment under the video.
Is cash on delivery available in my city?
You can get a refund within 14 days.
The shirt was too tight, so I asked for an exchange.

grammar.title: Verb + ing after prepositions (after, before, while, by...)
grammar.explanation_ar: الكلمات مثل after و before و while و when و about و by يأتي بعدها اسم أو ضمير (ويكون هو الفاعل ثم الفعل عادياً). أما إذا لم يأتِ فاعل وجاء بعدها فعل مباشرة، فيجب تحويل الفعل إلى اسم بإضافة ing.
examples: After James finished work, he left.
After typing his password, he scrolled down.
Before clicking "add to cart", check the size.

grammar.title: Modal verbs + base form
grammar.explanation_ar: الأفعال الناقصة (modal verbs) مثل can, could, may, might, must, should, will, would لا تتغير أبداً: لا تأخذ s ولا ed ولا ing. ويأتي بعدها الفعل في شكله الأساسي فقط، وكذلك كل فعل معطوف عليه في نفس الجملة.
examples: He could return the item and get a refund or ask for an exchange.
You must measure your feet first.

grammar.title: Keep the past tense in past stories
grammar.explanation_ar: في العربية نقول «شرح أنه يستطيع» في الماضي، لكن في الإنجليزية إذا كانت القصة في الماضي نحافظ على الزمن: explained that he could وليس can.
examples: James explained that he could return it.
She said that she was tired.
He usually paid by credit card.

questions.question: The address linked to your bank card is the:
questions.explanation_ar: billing address هو العنوان المسجّل مع بطاقتك في البنك.

questions.question: He ___ a pizza from the menu.
questions.explanation_ar: اختيار من قائمة فيها أشياء متشابهة = select.

questions.question: It was hard to ___ between living in the city and living in the village.
questions.explanation_ar: الاختيار بين بدائل مختلفة عن بعضها = choose.

questions.question: After ___ his password, Omar scrolled through the new collection.
questions.explanation_ar: بعد after إذا لم يأتِ فاعل نضيف ing للفعل.

questions.question: James explained that Omar ___ return the item.
questions.explanation_ar: القصة في الماضي، لذلك نقول could.

questions.question: He could return the shoes and ___ a refund.
questions.explanation_ar: بعد الفعل الناقص could يأتي الفعل في شكله الأساسي، وكذلك الفعل المعطوف عليه.

questions.question: The shoes were ___ small, so he couldn't wear them.
questions.explanation_ar: too = أكثر من اللازم لدرجة أنه لا يناسب.

questions.question: You create a new account when you:
questions.explanation_ar: sign up = تسجيل حساب جديد، و log in = الدخول إلى حساب موجود.
